acceptance: The test and _validate_mandatory_sites use one shared definition of which files may hold the benchmark gate
The test still fails if no benchmark_gate site exists in either file
context: Release canary has failed on this test in every red run since 2026-10-06 (runs 37481029046, 37641510012, 37798380568). Release PRs are blocked while the canary is red.
description: tests/integration/test_compat_lint_clean_resource_heavy.py:21 selects benchmark_gate entries whose file ends with run.py and asserts the list is not empty. The gate now lives in benchbox/cli/run_platform_resolution.py, so the list is empty and the release canary fails (shard 5, `assert []`). The production check in benchbox/sql_compat/inventory.py:670 already accepts both run.py and run_platform_resolution.py. Make the test use the same condition, ideally by sharing it rather than copying it, so the test cannot drift from the production check again.
